entities.summary: John Hanning Speke was an English explorer and army officer who made three exploratory expeditions to Africa. He is most associated with the search for the source of the Nile and, with Richard Burton, was the first European to reach Lake Victoria. John Hanning Speke was a logicians & mathematicians from Bideford (1827-05-04, Bideford–1864-09-15). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
